gloss: just the other day; only recently

definitions.gloss: just the other day; only recently; not long ago
definitions.explanation: An emphatic way of saying 'the other day,' stressing that the event happened very recently — typically within the last few days or weeks.

examples.japanese: つい{先日|せんじつ}⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: I just saw them the other day.

examples.japanese: つい{先日|せんじつ}、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Just the other day, a new restaurant opened.

examples.japanese: つい{先日|せんじつ}⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れて→割れる：00907_wareru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I dropped the smartphone I had just bought the other day and cracked the screen.

notes:
つい adds emphasis to ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧ (the other day), making it feel more immediate — 'just' the other day. The つい here conveys the sense of 'only just' or 'so recently that it still feels fresh.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- つい{先日|せんじつ}～⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ — just the other day (with ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ for further emphasis)
- つい{先日|せんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ — it was just the other day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧ — the other day (without the 'just' emphasis)
- つい⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧ — just recently
- ⟦つい{昨日|きのう}→つい昨日：28030_tsuikinou⟧ — just yesterday
- ⟦この{間|あいだ}→この間：01257_konoaida⟧ — the other day, recently (more casual)
